title: Brand Designer, Amazon Leo
description:
Description

Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable, high-speed connectivity.

Amazon Leo is seeking a talented Brand Designer to join our growing creative team. In this role, you'll work across mediums to define the look and feel of small- to mid-sized campaigns under the guidance of senior creative leadership. Through the design of compelling visual components and campaign identity systems, you'll bring creative concepts to life in uniquely ownable ways that showcase Leo's positioning in the satellite broadband market.

Key job responsibilities



-  Create design toolkits for brand campaigns that scale with efficiency and consistency across all Amazon channels
-  Flex between tools such as Sketch, Figma, or Adobe XD to deliver design systems that fit into partner teams' workflows
-  Articulate design decisions and rationale, internally and externally, through well-developed presentation and communication skills
-  Steward Leo's brand tone and voice through every stage of campaign development, including elevating pitch materials with consideration for brand guidelines
-  Address stakeholder needs and brief objectives through design explorations, rationale, and presentations
-  Manage multiple parallel-path projects while maintaining attention to detail
-  Raise the creative bar through error-free designs, visual flair, conceptual excellence, and design polish, while staying on time and within budget
-  Possess a strong understanding of design, layout, video, photography, typography, and wide-ranging interactive technologies, and proactively share knowledge with the creative team
-  Collaborate across disciplines with team members at all levels
-  Leverage generative AI tools to enhance creative workflows, develop concepts, and accelerate ideation processes
-  Prioritize design accessibility standards to deliver compelling designs to the widest audience possible

Export Control Requirement

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

A day in the life

Your day starts with a creative review, presenting design concepts for an upcoming Leo product launch to senior leadership. You refine a campaign toolkit in Figma, ensuring brand consistency across digital and print touchpoints. Mid-morning, you collaborate with a copywriter on social assets, then jump into After Effects to add motion to a key visual. You wrap up iterating on stakeholder feedback, prepping files for a press check, and exploring AI-generated concepts for next week's creative review.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Hi! 👋 I'm Chris, head of Product Design at Ashby.

We're looking for a versatile, intrinsically motivated designer who is excited to contribute to rethinking how modern software is designed. At Ashby, you'll be part designer, part product manager, part consultant, and part design system manager (or some combination of the 4!). We do design differently here, and if that excites you, read on.

Our unique approach is working - we're growing >100% year-over-year and have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, very low churn, and many years of runway. We're backed by amazing investors like Y Combinator, Elad Gil, Lachy Groom, and many more! We’ll share more details once we meet.

How We Work

In my previous roles, product teams always consisted of a product manager, a designer, and ~4-5 engineers. This may sound familiar to you! The product manager briefs the designer who then designs. After designing, mocks are handed to the engineers.

We take a more principled approach here at Ashby. If you've been designing software enough, you'll realize in actuality, design is required in varying degrees on each project. Sometimes in the past, I'd be asked to design yet another settings page, when really all that was needed was an engineer to reuse existing components and just follow some documentation I had written. Other times, I felt I should effectively be the product manager and own a project from beginning to end. In these latter cases, it made sense that I was even the one providing project updates and managing resources rather than constantly being pinged by a separate product manager.

This principled approach is now what we do here, and it is part of what has allowed Ashby to take down incumbents in multiple verticals all at once. We don't settle for the status quo—we actively resist reversion to the mean.

Currently, I report to Benji, the co-founder & CEO. Both Abhik and Benji (our founders) care deeply about design, which at first glance may seem counterintuitive given the number of full-time designers that we employ. The belief is not that design is unimportant, but rather that it should be owned by the product team collectively, not solely by a group of full-time designers who happen to have the job title.

The design department’s job at Ashby is not to make every single design decision but to equip our entire product team to make better decisions themselves, as well as edit decisions that PMs/Engineers choose to make. That, while tackling the biggest design challenges ourselves.

Separate from design, you may also be excited by the fact that we maintain a near seed-stage-like culture with fuzzy lines between functional roles, as much autonomy as you can handle, and a focus on IC-work with an almost-no-meeting culture. title: Staff Product Designer
description:
A Better Built World

At Miter, we’re on a mission to help construction contractors build with confidence. If we’re successful, we’ll make it easier and faster to build critical physical infrastructure - roads, bridges, utilities, data centers, housing, etc.

For decades, construction and field services contractors have had to run their businesses on outdated software: clunky, on-premise systems created in the 1980s and 1990s.

That’s where Miter comes in. We’re using AI and embedded payments to rebuild the core HR, finance, and operations systems that underpin our physical economy. Using Miter, contractors like Marathon Electrical, W.J. O’Neil, and Truebeck Construction are building stronger teams, controlling job costs, and accelerating jobsite execution.

This idea is resonating. Since we launched in 2021, we’ve grown to thousands of customers and tens of millions in ARR, making us one of the fastest growing vertical software companies ever. To double-down on our momentum, we’ve raised $50M+ from top investors (Bessemer, Coatue, and Battery) who share our belief that we’re just getting started.

About the Team & How We Work:

Miter is helping contractors re-design their businesses, giving them tools to better manage the complex workflows and challenges they face in the back office and at the job site. We’re in the early days of our journey, and the potential to transform construction for the better is massive.

Design is AI first and builder-led at Miter. We leverage tools like Cursor and Claude to move quickly from idea to concept, explore flows and interactions, and then progress to Figma and Storybook for systems and polish. We stay close to the customer, ship quickly to learn, and embrace new ways of working.

As Staff Product Designer, you’ll play a critical role by leading design strategy and execution. You’ll meet with our customers to learn about their unique needs and workflows. You’ll collaborate daily with product and engineering, enabling the team to ship features that raise the bar on quality and user experience (and even shipping small features of your own). And you’ll play a key role shaping how we leverage AI to deliver consistent, delightful UX.

What You’ll Do:



- Own design strategy and execution (interaction design, design system and componentry) across the Miter platform
- Partner closely with peers in engineering and product (as well as cross-functional teams at Miter) to shape the user experience for both new and existing Miter apps
- Work directly with our customers to learn how they use Miter and how it fits into the complex workflows that they use to run their business
- Help shape the vision for AI capabilities at Miter and bring a user-centered lens to AI-powered functionality
- Experiment with new AI tools, processes, and ways of working across product, design, and engineering
- Operate with pragmatism and a first-principles approach to help the team deliver value to customers quickly and consistently

title: Innovation Product Designer
description:
At BBH, Partnership is more than a form of ownership—it’s our approach to business and relationships. We know that supporting your professional and personal goals is the best way to help our clients and advance our business. We take that responsibility seriously. With a 200-year legacy and a shared passion for what’s next, this is the right place to build a fulfilling career.

About Us

We are on a mission to rebuild how financial services firms create, manage, and execute their data integrations and transformations. Today that process stretches across multiple teams, tools, and handoffs - slow to build, expensive to maintain, and nearly impossible to change. We collapse it into a single AI-native platform that business users can operate without writing a ticket, while engineering teams retain the governance and security controls they require. title: UI/UX Product Designer - AI Trainer
description:
About The Job

We are looking for an existing UI/UX Product Designer to help train AI models. You will measure the progress of these AI chatbots, evaluate their logic, and solve problems to improve the quality of each model.

In this role, you’ll use your design expertise to evaluate AI outputs, provide detailed feedback, and help refine the model’s sense of aesthetics, usability, and creative quality. Your insights will directly shape how the next generation of AI tools supports designers.

This is a new and growing area for our company — focused on teaching AI to better understand visual and design principles. At this stage, designers should apply through our general core assessment and then complete a qualification for Web & UI/UX Design. Once approved, you’ll not only have access to general AI training projects but also be invited to contribute to design-specific projects. These projects focus on areas such as UI/UX critique, product visuals, and aesthetic evaluation (including presentations and creative deliverables).

Advantages Of Contracting With Us



- You'll be able to choose which projects you want to work on and when
- You work on your own schedule, on your own computer, from the comfort of your own home
- General AI training projects start at $25-$30+ USD/hr, while design-focused projects start at $40+ USD/hr, with higher bonus rates available for certain projects

Responsibilities



- Review and critique AI-generated UI/UX designs, mockups, and visuals
- Evaluate the quality produced by AI models for correctness and performance
- Help train models to better understand aesthetic quality and user-centered design

Qualifications



- Fluency in English (native or bilingual level)
- Background in UI/UX design, web design, product design, or graphic design
- Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, interaction design, and user flow
- Excellent command of grammar, style, and brand voice
- A current, in progress, or completed Bachelor's is preferred but not required

Note: Payment is made via PayPal. We will never ask for any money from you. PayPal will handle any currency conversions from USD. Only applicants in the United States will be considered for this role. This is an independent contractor position.

description:
Serving the needs of all families with young children, Carter’s Inc. is the largest North American apparel retailer exclusively for babies and young children, encompassing Carter’s, OshKosh B’gosh, Skip*Hop and Little Planet brands. Meaningful work, constant learning, genuine people, and a community guided by core values that promote inclusion and innovation is in everything we do. There are many reasons to build your career at Carter's.

How You’ll Make An Impact

This role reports to the Carter’s Brand Art Director and is based in our Buckhead office on site 4 days/week.

This is a highly craft-focused role at the center of a major brand transformation. You will help bring a newly evolved Carter’s brand to life across all touchpoints—building and scaling a modern, cohesive visual identity system. This role blends strong foundational design with emerging motion capabilities, ensuring the brand feels both elevated and dynamic in today’s landscape.

You will play a critical role in developing brand guidelines, creating design systems, shaping laydown photography, evolving packaging, and introducing thoughtful motion and animation that enhances storytelling and brand expression.

50%: Brand identity & guideline development



- Support the creation, rollout, and ongoing evolution of Carter’s new brand guidelines.
- Translate brand strategy into clear, scalable design systems including typography, color, layout, iconography, and graphic elements.
- Build flexible toolkits and templates that enable consistency across teams, channels, and partners.
- Partner closely with Creative leadership to define and refine the future visual expression of the brand.
- Act as a steward of the new brand—ensuring consistency while thoughtfully evolving the system over time.

20%: Brand design & creative execution



- Concept and design brand-forward creative across marketing, retail, and owned channels—translating strategy into elevated, cohesive work that resonates with modern families.
- Collaborate cross-functionally to bring campaigns to life while maintaining a high bar for craft, consistency, and attention to detail across all deliverables.

20%: Laydown photography & packaging design



- Partner with Art Directors and photography teams to concept and execute laydown photography that aligns with brand standards.
- Provide direction on composition, styling and prop usage to ensure a cohesive brand look and feel.
- Design and evolve packaging systems that reflect the Carter’s brand identity and stand out in retail environments.
- Ensure packaging and photography work together seamlessly as part of a holistic brand experience.

10%: Motion & animation



- Bring the brand to life through thoughtful, simple motion design across digital touchpoints.
- Create animations for social, digital marketing, presentations, and brand moments.
- Ensure motion aligns with and enhances the overall brand identity—not just decorates it.

description:
About Niche

Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.

About The Role

Every year, millions of families start the school search process. Students wade through a sea of information and decisions to make, and unfortunately access to help hasn’t changed much in decades: it’s not super clear what your options are, and you might not feel confident that a school is right for them, or think you’ll be able to afford it.

Niche is on a mission to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. Students need support choosing a school and paying for their education, schools want to find students who will thrive on their campus, and families need help supporting their students every step of the way. Niche helps ensure that it’s not just students already confident about college who get enrolled and can afford to attend.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to continuously improve our partner school experiences focused on AI-generated message content and student-level personalized communication across web and mobile. Several of these features are brand new and we need your expertise to refine and enhance them in order to get more students connected with schools who are interested in them specifically, helping the school’s authentic voice shine through and ensuring touch points help nurture students productively toward becoming fully enrolled. You will play a critical role in a growing space, working closely with cross-functional teams on creating seamless, effective experiences that determine the future of personalized school application and enrollment.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to flex across user research, IA and content design, conceptual models, interactions and UI flows. That being said, we value the foundations of our UX practice and you will still work the design process, show your thinking, participate in critiques and design reviews, etc.

A career in IBM Software means you’ll be leading the teams that transform our customers’ challenges into world-class solutions.

You will be leading a design team dedicated to HashiCorp’s industry-leading suite of security products. As the standard for cloud infrastructure automation, HashiCorp products (like Vault and Boundary) are critical to the world’s largest organizations. We are seeking a leader who understands the delicate balance between robust security and seamless developer experience.

Our door is open for a visionary leader who wants to build and guide a team to deliver winning results in the high-stakes world of Zero Trust security and identity management.

Your Role And Responsibilities

Vault is a complex product customers rely on to secure their most critical systems and workloads. If you love solving interesting, novel problems, this is a role you’ll enjoy. - Be a passionate designer who thrives in uncertainty and ambiguity.

- You are comfortable working across a distributed, global team.

We're backed by amazing investors like Y Combinator, Elad Gil, Lachy Groom, and many more! We’ll share more details once we meet.

How We Work

In my previous roles, product teams always consisted of a product manager, a designer, and ~4-5 engineers. This may sound familiar to you! The product manager briefs the designer who then designs. After designing, mocks are handed to the engineers.

We take a more principled approach here at Ashby. If you've been designing software enough, you'll realize in actuality, design is required in varying degrees on each project. Sometimes in the past, I'd be asked to design yet another settings page, when really all that was needed was an engineer to reuse existing components and just follow some documentation I had written. Other times, I felt I should effectively be the product manager and own a project from beginning to end. In these latter cases, it made sense that I was even the one providing project updates and managing resources rather than constantly being pinged by a separate product manager.

This principled approach is now what we do here, and it is part of what has allowed Ashby to take down incumbents in multiple verticals all at once. We don't settle for the status quo—we actively resist reversion to the mean.

Currently, I report to Benji, the co-founder & CEO. Both Abhik and Benji (our founders) care deeply about design, which at first glance may seem counterintuitive given the number of full-time designers that we employ. The belief is not that design is unimportant, but rather that it should be owned by the product team collectively, not solely by a group of full-time designers who happen to have the job title.

The design department’s job at Ashby is not to make every single design decision but to equip our entire product team to make better decisions themselves, as well as edit decisions that PMs/Engineers choose to make. That, while tackling the biggest design challenges ourselves.

Separate from design, you may also be excited by the fact that we maintain a near seed-stage-like culture with fuzzy lines between functional roles, as much autonomy as you can handle, and a focus on IC-work with an almost-no-meeting culture. title: Product UI Designer - AI Trainer
description:
About The Job

We are looking for an existing Product UI Designer to help train AI models. You will measure the progress of these AI chatbots, evaluate their logic, and solve problems to improve the quality of each model.

In this role, you’ll use your design expertise to evaluate AI outputs, provide detailed feedback, and help refine the model’s sense of aesthetics, usability, and creative quality. Your insights will directly shape how the next generation of AI tools supports designers.

This is a new and growing area for our company — focused on teaching AI to better understand visual and design principles. At this stage, designers should apply through our general core assessment and then complete a qualification for Web & UI/UX Design. Once approved, you’ll not only have access to general AI training projects but also be invited to contribute to design-specific projects. These projects focus on areas such as UI/UX critique, product visuals, and aesthetic evaluation (including presentations and creative deliverables).

Advantages Of Contracting With Us



- You'll be able to choose which projects you want to work on and when
- You work on your own schedule, on your own computer, from the comfort of your own home
- General AI training projects start at $25-$30+ USD/hr, while design-focused projects start at $40+ USD/hr, with higher bonus rates available for certain projects

Responsibilities



- Review and critique AI-generated UI/UX designs, mockups, and visuals
- Evaluate the quality produced by AI models for correctness and performance
- Help train models to better understand aesthetic quality and user-centered design

Qualifications



- Fluency in English (native or bilingual level)
- Background in UI/UX design, web design, product design, or graphic design
- Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, interaction design, and user flow
- Excellent command of grammar, style, and brand voice
- A current, in progress, or completed Bachelor's is preferred but not required

Note: Payment is made via PayPal. We will never ask for any money from you. PayPal will handle any currency conversions from USD. Only applicants in the United States will be considered for this role. This is an independent contractor position.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Why it’s worth it:

Joining our team means immersing yourself in a dynamic, collaborative environment where creativity thrives. You'll work alongside talented designers, videographers, and web developers, contributing to projects that span print, digital, animation and large-scale events. As part of an integrated marketing team, you'll be empowered to grow both personally and professionally in a company that values and supports a growth mindset. Most importantly, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact to a company that is working to solve some of the most complex challenges in the cybersecurity industry, driving innovation in a field that truly matters.

 

The everyday hustle:

- Design motion concepts, storyboards, and animatics that support user flows and brand messaging

- Brainstorm and develop unique, on-brand design concepts for campaigns, projects, and events.

- Experience leading other designers and giving constructive feedback

title: Product Designer - AI Trainer
description:
About The Job

We are looking for an existing Product Designer to help train AI models. You will measure the progress of these AI chatbots, evaluate their logic, and solve problems to improve the quality of each model.

In this role, you’ll use your design expertise to evaluate AI outputs, provide detailed feedback, and help refine the model’s sense of aesthetics, usability, and creative quality. Your insights will directly shape how the next generation of AI tools supports designers.

This is a new and growing area for our company — focused on teaching AI to better understand visual and design principles. At this stage, designers should apply through our general core assessment and then complete a qualification for Web & UI/UX Design. Once approved, you’ll not only have access to general AI training projects but also be invited to contribute to design-specific projects. These projects focus on areas such as UI/UX critique, product visuals, and aesthetic evaluation (including presentations and creative deliverables).

Advantages Of Contracting With Us



- You'll be able to choose which projects you want to work on and when
- You work on your own schedule, on your own computer, from the comfort of your own home
- General AI training projects start at $25-$30+ USD/hr, while design-focused projects start at $40+ USD/hr, with higher bonus rates available for certain projects

Responsibilities



- Review and critique AI-generated UI/UX designs, mockups, and visuals
- Evaluate the quality produced by AI models for correctness and performance
- Help train models to better understand aesthetic quality and user-centered design

Qualifications



- Fluency in English (native or bilingual level)
- Background in UI/UX design, web design, product design, or graphic design
- Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, interaction design, and user flow
- Excellent command of grammar, style, and brand voice
- A current, in progress, or completed Bachelor's is preferred but not required

Note: Payment is made via PayPal. We will never ask for any money from you. PayPal will handle any currency conversions from USD. Only applicants in the United States will be considered for this role. This is an independent contractor position.

In this role, you’ll use your design expertise to evaluate AI outputs, provide detailed feedback, and help refine the model’s sense of aesthetics, usability, and creative quality. Your insights will directly shape how the next generation of AI tools supports designers.

This is a new and growing area for our company — focused on teaching AI to better understand visual and design principles. At this stage, designers should apply through our general core assessment and then complete a qualification for Web & UI/UX Design. Once approved, you’ll not only have access to general AI training projects but also be invited to contribute to design-specific projects. These projects focus on areas such as UI/UX critique, product visuals, and aesthetic evaluation (including presentations and creative deliverables).

Advantages Of Contracting With Us



- You'll be able to choose which projects you want to work on and when
- You work on your own schedule, on your own computer, from the comfort of your own home
- General AI training projects start at $25-$30+ USD/hr, while design-focused projects start at $40+ USD/hr, with higher bonus rates available for certain projects

Responsibilities



- Review and critique AI-generated UI/UX designs, mockups, and visuals
- Evaluate the quality produced by AI models for correctness and performance
- Help train models to better understand aesthetic quality and user-centered design

Qualifications



- Fluency in English (native or bilingual level)
- Background in UI/UX design, web design, product design, or graphic design
- Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, interaction design, and user flow
- Excellent command of grammar, style, and brand voice
- A current, in progress, or completed Bachelor's is preferred but not required

Note: Payment is made via PayPal. We will never ask for any money from you. PayPal will handle any currency conversions from USD. Only applicants in the United States will be considered for this role. This is an independent contractor position.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Hi! 👋 I'm Chris, head of Product Design at Ashby.

We're looking for a versatile, intrinsically motivated designer who is excited to contribute to rethinking how modern software is designed. At Ashby, you'll be part designer, part product manager, part consultant, and part design system manager (or some combination of the 4!). We do design differently here, and if that excites you, read on.

Our unique approach is working - we're growing >100% year-over-year and have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, very low churn, and many years of runway. We're backed by amazing investors like Y Combinator, Elad Gil, Lachy Groom, and many more! We’ll share more details once we meet.

How We Work

In my previous roles, product teams always consisted of a product manager, a designer, and ~4-5 engineers. This may sound familiar to you! The product manager briefs the designer who then designs. After designing, mocks are handed to the engineers.

We take a more principled approach here at Ashby. If you've been designing software enough, you'll realize in actuality, design is required in varying degrees on each project. Sometimes in the past, I'd be asked to design yet another settings page, when really all that was needed was an engineer to reuse existing components and just follow some documentation I had written. Other times, I felt I should effectively be the product manager and own a project from beginning to end. In these latter cases, it made sense that I was even the one providing project updates and managing resources rather than constantly being pinged by a separate product manager.

This principled approach is now what we do here, and it is part of what has allowed Ashby to take down incumbents in multiple verticals all at once. We don't settle for the status quo—we actively resist reversion to the mean.

Currently, I report to Benji, the co-founder & CEO. Both Abhik and Benji (our founders) care deeply about design, which at first glance may seem counterintuitive given the number of full-time designers that we employ. The belief is not that design is unimportant, but rather that it should be owned by the product team collectively, not solely by a group of full-time designers who happen to have the job title.

The design department’s job at Ashby is not to make every single design decision but to equip our entire product team to make better decisions themselves, as well as edit decisions that PMs/Engineers choose to make. That, while tackling the biggest design challenges ourselves.

Separate from design, you may also be excited by the fact that we maintain a near seed-stage-like culture with fuzzy lines between functional roles, as much autonomy as you can handle, and a focus on IC-work with an almost-no-meeting culture. title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Title: Sr. UX Product Designer
Industry: Airline / Digital Customer Experience
Location: Dallas- Fort Worth, TX (Hybrid – Tues–Thurs onsite, Mon/Fri remote)
Duration: Long term contract (through EOY with yearly extensions)
Pay Rate: $62/hr


Job Description:
We are seeking Sr. UX Product Designers to join a Digital Customer Experience team within a large enterprise organization. This multidisciplinary UX team drives user experiences across both customer-facing and employee-facing applications.


This is a highly collaborative role working with cross-functional product teams to own initiatives from concept through implementation. You will influence product direction through user-centered design, research, and data-driven decision-making. This position may align to product-focused delivery or Design Operations, helping scale standards, systems, and processes across the enterprise.


Key Responsibilities:
• Lead end-to-end UX design efforts from ideation through execution across web, mobile, and desktop experiences
• Influence product decisions using UX best practices, research insights, and design principles within agile environments
• Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and stakeholders to deliver effective and scalable solutions
• Create wireframes, journey maps, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs aligned to design systems
• Define interaction flows, visual design standards, and information architecture
• Conduct and apply user research including usability testing, interviews, and heuristic evaluations
• Develop research strategies, test plans, and hypotheses to iterate on design solutions
• Present design concepts and rationale clearly to stakeholders using strong storytelling skills
• Track progress and communicate updates, risks, and dependencies using tools such as Jira, Rally, or Aha!
• Ensure designs are responsive, accessible, and optimized for multiple platforms
• Support and contribute to design systems and enterprise-wide UX standards
• Mentor and guide other designers to promote collaboration and growth


Required Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in HCI, Human Factors, Computer Science, Visual Design, or related field (or equivalent experience)
• 3+ years of experience in UX design, interaction design, or related role
• Experience working in agile environments and partnering closely with Engineering teams
• Strong portfolio demonstrating user-centered design process and outcomes
• Experience designing for mobile (iOS/Android), web, and desktop applications
• Proficiency in user research methods (qualitative and quantitative)
• Strong collaboration skills across cross-functional teams and stakeholders
• Experience with responsive, adaptive, and accessible design


Preferred Qualifications:
• 5+ years of UX design experience
• Master’s degree in a related field
• Experience with accessibility standards (WCAG 2.0+ AA), inclusive design, and localization
• Background in both product design and DesignOps environment

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Clients benefit from personalized guidance tailored to their unique financial goals and life stages. Team members collaborate closely with advisors who are committed to high professional standards and client-focused service, offering an environment focused on integrity, expertise, and long-term relationships.
Role Description The Senior Design Director is a full-time, remote role responsible for leading the design vision and execution across the practice’s client-facing and internal experiences. This role oversees the end-to-end design process, from initial concept through delivery, ensuring that visual identity, digital and physical touchpoints, and communications consistently reflect the firm’s brand and client-centric values. Day-to-day responsibilities include managing design projects, directing design teams or external vendors, developing brand guidelines, and creating design solutions that support financial planning, marketing, and client education initiatives. Role Description

The Designer will be a core contributor to how Newton Research looks and sounds across every surface - from our website and product marketing to social content and sales collateral. This is a generalist design role with a creative edge. title: Digital Product Designer - AI Trainer
description:
About The Job

We are looking for an existing Digital Product Designer to help train AI models. You will measure the progress of these AI chatbots, evaluate their logic, and solve problems to improve the quality of each model.

In this role, you’ll use your design expertise to evaluate AI outputs, provide detailed feedback, and help refine the model’s sense of aesthetics, usability, and creative quality. Your insights will directly shape how the next generation of AI tools supports designers.

This is a new and growing area for our company — focused on teaching AI to better understand visual and design principles. At this stage, designers should apply through our general core assessment and then complete a qualification for Web & UI/UX Design. Once approved, you’ll not only have access to general AI training projects but also be invited to contribute to design-specific projects. These projects focus on areas such as UI/UX critique, product visuals, and aesthetic evaluation (including presentations and creative deliverables).

Advantages Of Contracting With Us



- You'll be able to choose which projects you want to work on and when
- You work on your own schedule, on your own computer, from the comfort of your own home
- General AI training projects start at $25-$30+ USD/hr, while design-focused projects start at $40+ USD/hr, with higher bonus rates available for certain projects

Responsibilities



- Review and critique AI-generated UI/UX designs, mockups, and visuals
- Evaluate the quality produced by AI models for correctness and performance
- Help train models to better understand aesthetic quality and user-centered design

Qualifications



- Fluency in English (native or bilingual level)
- Background in UI/UX design, web design, product design, or graphic design
- Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, interaction design, and user flow
- Excellent command of grammar, style, and brand voice
- A current, in progress, or completed Bachelor's is preferred but not required

GOAT USA is seeking a creative and detail-oriented Designer to help shape and grow our Women's and Girls’ apparel collections. title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Our Mission

Our mission is to bring web3 to a billion people, by providing builders with the tools they need to build exceptional onchain products. Alchemy is the only complete developer platform that offers the powerful APIs, SDKs, and tools necessary to build and scale onchain apps and rollups.

Our infrastructure powers 70% of the top web3 teams, 90%+ of web2 companies building in web3 and 100+ million end users. Our customers include top web3 brands like Polymarket, OpenSea, Circle, WorldCoin, as well as major global brands like Shopify and Adobe.

The Alchemy team draws from decades of deep expertise in massively scalable infrastructure, AI, and blockchain from leadership roles at leading companies and universities like Google, Microsoft, Facebook, Stanford, and MIT.

We're backed by the world's leading VCs and institutions, including: Lightspeed, Silver Lake, a16z, Coatue, Pantera, Addition, Stanford University, Coinbase, and Charles Schwab, among others.

About The Role

As a Product Designer you'll sit at the intersection of product design, product thinking, and front-end engineering—someone who can take early, ambiguous ideas and turn them into interactive, evaluable experiences fast, helping teams make better decisions sooner.

This role is front-end and systems-heavy, with a strong balance of hands-on building and product design partnership. You’ll help us scale and evolve Alchemy’s UI system—owning core components, patterns, and implementation quality—while also jumping into product work when needed to unblock teams and raise the craft bar.

This is a high-leverage role: you’ll reduce handoff friction, increase prototype velocity, and elevate UI quality through hands-on building, close collaboration, and a strong point of view on systems.

What You'll Do



- Build production-quality prototypes (and, when appropriate, ship production front-end code) to validate UX direction quickly—often on tight timelines.
- Own and evolve Alchemy’s design system in practice: build and maintain reusable components, patterns, and interaction primitives that scale across products.
- Translate design intent into high-quality React/TypeScript UI, with attention to spacing, hierarchy, motion, and interaction polish.
- Drive system scalability: identify gaps, propose improvements, and ship additions that make the product ecosystem more consistent and faster to build.
- Partner closely with product designers to improve the craft and feasibility of design work—bringing an engineer’s pragmatism and a designer’s taste.
- Collaborate tightly with product engineers to reduce rework and make the path from prototype → implementation smoother.
- Improve “how we build UI” muscle across teams: documentation, examples, and workflow improvements that raise the baseline.
- Build for an AI-native product future: create interaction patterns and UI foundations that support rapid experimentation and iteration in AI-driven experiences.
- Contribute to design-system adoption

title: Principal Product Designer
description:
Lead design strategy for Gallup products that enhance people’s work and lives.

As a principal product designer at Gallup, you will serve as the strategic design leader for CliftonStrengths® or Gallup’s employee experience platform, Gallup Access, defining what we build and how it comes to life across every customer touchpoint. You will bring together web, mobile and marketing into one cohesive customer journey, ensuring that every interaction reflects the clarity and impact of the science behind it.

In this role, you’ll influence product direction, translate complex insights into intuitive experiences and elevate design quality across the organization.

What You’ll Do



- Own and elevate the product design vision, setting standards for experience quality across the ecosystem
- Lead and align designers across web, mobile and marketing, ensuring clarity of direction and consistency of execution
- Partner with product and engineering to define opportunity spaces, shape product strategy and guide solution development
- Work closely with senior scientists to make complex research and data accessible, intuitive and actionable for users
- Strengthen and evolve scalable design systems that enable cross-platform consistency and long-term growth
- Create high-level prototypes and experience concepts that bring strategic direction to life
- Shape the design culture of the team by investing in the growth of individual designers, raising the bar for craft, and fostering an environment of continuous learning and excellence
- Influence senior stakeholders through clear communication and confident design rationale
- Explore emerging tools and AI-enabled workflows that improve how we design, prototype and collaborate

What Makes You Stand Out



- Ecosystem leadership: You have experience aligning multiple teams or product groups around a unified design vision.
- Systems-scale thinker: You have built or evolved design systems and understand component architecture, governance and cross-team adoption at scale.
- Outcome-oriented operator: You prioritize getting meaningful work done over tooling preferences and adapt quickly as workflows evolve.
- Complexity translator: You distill technical, data-rich or scientific content into intuitive user experiences that exceed expectations.
- Influential communicator: You confidently align senior stakeholders and cross-functional leaders around strategic design decisions.

What You Need



- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in human-computer interaction, product design, interaction design, computer science, cognitive science or related field, or equivalent experience, required
- At least 10 years of experience designing enterprise and consumer-facing digital products
- At least three years working at staff, principal or similar senior levels required

- Experience building, scaling or evolving design systems required

title: Visual Designer - AI Trainer
description:
About The Job

We are looking for an existing Visual Designer to help train AI models. You will measure the progress of these AI chatbots, evaluate their logic, and solve problems to improve the quality of each model.

In this role, you’ll use your design expertise to evaluate AI outputs, provide detailed feedback, and help refine the model’s sense of aesthetics, usability, and creative quality. Your insights will directly shape how the next generation of AI tools supports designers.

This is a new and growing area for our company — focused on teaching AI to better understand visual and design principles. At this stage, designers should apply through our general core assessment and then complete a qualification for Web & UI/UX Design. Once approved, you’ll not only have access to general AI training projects but also be invited to contribute to design-specific projects. These projects focus on areas such as UI/UX critique, product visuals, and aesthetic evaluation (including presentations and creative deliverables).

Advantages Of Contracting With Us



- You'll be able to choose which projects you want to work on and when
- You work on your own schedule, on your own computer, from the comfort of your own home
- General AI training projects start at $25-$30+ USD/hr, while design-focused projects start at $40+ USD/hr, with higher bonus rates available for certain projects

Responsibilities



- Review and critique AI-generated UI/UX designs, mockups, and visuals
- Evaluate the quality produced by AI models for correctness and performance
- Help train models to better understand aesthetic quality and user-centered design

Qualifications



- Fluency in English (native or bilingual level)
- Background in UI/UX design, web design, product design, or graphic design
- Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, interaction design, and user flow
- Excellent command of grammar, style, and brand voice
- A current, in progress, or completed Bachelor's is preferred but not required

Note: Payment is made via PayPal. We will never ask for any money from you. PayPal will handle any currency conversions from USD. Only applicants in the United States will be considered for this role. This is an independent contractor position.

description:
Description

The Devices & Services Experience Design (DxD) team leads user experience design innovation across Amazon's device portfolio, including Echo, Fire TV, Fire Tablets, Alexa.com, and related mobile apps. Our team works at the intersection of design, product and engineering, creating meaningful hardware and software experiences that enhance customer lives. We believe in storytelling and thinking holistically to craft the "why" behind everything we ship.

We're seeking a versatile UX Designer who is passionate about building incredible product experiences for the Echo Family of Devices and customers across the Amazon devices and services portfolio.

Our team is composed of multi-disciplinary designers who blend boundaries across UX design, visual, motion, and prototyping. We innovate end to end on product concepts starting from ideation of scenarios, to refined visual and conversational prototypes, to working with partner teams to execute and integrate seamlessly with devices.

We are makers at heart— transforming early concepts into high-fidelity, interactive experiences that leverage device capabilities across vision systems, audio, touch, gesture and natural modes of interaction.

Storytelling is integrated into daily work of the design team - communicating strategy to diverse stakeholders, helping others see future possibilities today.

We create clarity from ambiguity, solving problems and when there are multiple considerations and tradeoffs to consider.

You will be participating in a deeply collaborative team, partnering with cross-functional groups across design disciplines, research, developers and product managers. Your hands-on approach builds trust and elevates the work of those around you.

Every day we push boundaries to turn ideas into tangible experiences that inspire partners, leaders and customers.

-  Bring product concepts to life through high fidelity visuals, motion, videos, and interaction prototyping
-  Navigate all phases of the design cycle—from discovery and ideation through refinement and execution
-  Collaborate with diverse stakeholders including research, product management, developers and design leaders and communicate design strategy through compelling storytelling.
-  Thrive in ambiguity, generating divergent concepts while identifying compelling ideas worth deeper exploration.
-  Synthesize industry trends, customer needs, and competitive insights into meaningful experiences.
-  Balance collaborative teamwork with autonomous execution in a small, highly skilled team.

The Domains UX team is within Amazon's Devices Experience Design group (DxD). We are a high impact design team shaping how customers listen, watch, learn, and stay organized through Audio, Video, News, and Productivity experiences.
